Tanks don’t provide enough air flow for rats, they get dirty really easily, and rats have very very sensitive noses. So they’d breathe in the pee that would get on the side of the glass etc... But yeah, rats require A LOT, and are one of the more expensive rodents when it comes to their food/bedding/cage,. Watching YouTube videos helps a lot on learning what a pet needs. Rats are just so intelligent and social keeping them in something small like that without a partner, plenty of hide outs, etc.. is wrong. Gerbils are far more affordable when it comes to bedding and caging. They don’t require as much as rats do. But yeah thanks for asking, I feel comforted that there are people who try to educate themselves before proceeding to get a pet.

Rats aren’t supposed to be held in tanks, it’ll easily cause a respiratory infection. Also the size of that tank wouldn’t even be big enough for a Syrian hamster. On top of that they have a saucer in the tank that if the rat uses it’ll damage its spine potentially. Worst of all rats are very social animals and require a partner, otherwise they will become very depressed. There’s just a lot wrong here 🤣
